def dtw(a,b,window,metric):

   d=a[i-1]-b[j-1];table[i,j]=(d*d if not metric else abs(d))+min(table[i-1,j-1],table[i-1,j],table[i,j-1])

def exhaustive_dtw(a,b,window,metric):

   if i+di<len(a)and j+dj<len(b):visit(i+di,j+dj,cost)
 visit(0,0,0.);return np.sqrt(best)if not metric else best
